verses.translation: Alleluia. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy endures for ever.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi pe Domnul că este bun, că în veac este mila Lui.
translations.grk: Ἀλληλούϊα. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ Κυρίῳ, ὅτι χρηστὸς, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Let them say so who have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

translations.ron: Să spună cei izbăviţi de Domnul, pe care i-a izbăvit din mâna vrăjmaşului.
translations.grk: Εἰπάτωσαν οἱ λελυτρωμένοι ὑπὸ Κυρίου, οὓς ἐλυτρώσατο ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ,

verses.translation: and gathered them out of the countries, from the east, and west, and north, and south.

translations.ron: Din ţări i-a adunat pe ei, de la răsărit şi de la apus, de la miazănoapte şi de la miazăzi.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν συνήγαγεν αὐτούς· ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν, καὶ δυσμῶν, καὶ βοῤῥᾶ, καὶ θαλάσσης.

verses.translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a dry land; they found no way to a city of habitation.

translations.ron: Rătăcit-au în pustie, în pământ fără de apă şi cale spre cetatea de locuit n-au găsit.
translations.grk: Ἐπλανήθησαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν ἀνύδρῳ· ὁδὸν πόλεως κατοικητηρίου οὐχ εὗρον·

verses.translation: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

translations.ron: Erau flămânzi şi însetaţi; sufletul lor într-înşii se sfârşea;
translations.grk: Πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες, ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐξέλιπε.

verses.translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

translations.ron: Dar au strigat către Domnul în necazurile lor şi din nevoile lor i-a izbăvit pe ei
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἐῤῥύσατο αὐτούς·

verses.translation: And he guided them into a straight path, that they might go to a city of habitation.

translations.ron: Şi i-a povăţuit pe cale dreaptă, ca să meargă spre cetatea de locuit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ὁδὸν εὐθεῖαν, τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς πόλιν κατοικητηρίου.

verses.translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

translations.ron: Lăudat să fie Domnul pentru milele Lui, pentru minunile Lui, pe care le-a făcut fiilor oamenilor.
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ Κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.translation: For he satisfies the empty soul, and fills the hungry soul with good things,

translations.ron: Că a săturat suflet însetat şi suflet flămând a umplut de bunătăţi.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐχόρτασε ψυχὴν κενὴν, καὶ πεινῶσαν ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν.

verses.translation: even them that sit in darkness and the shadow of death, fettered in poverty and iron;

translations.ron: Şedeau în întuneric şi în umbra morţii; erau ferecaţi de sărăcie şi de fier,
translations.grk: Καθημένους ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου, πεπεδημένους ἐν πτωχείᾳ καὶ σιδήρῳ·

verses.translation: because they rebelled against the words of God, and provoked the counsel of the Most High.

translations.ron: Pentru că au amărât cuvintele Domnului şi sfatul Celui Preaînalt au întărâtat.
translations.grk: Ὅτι παρεπίκραναν τὰ λόγια τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ ὑψίστου παρώξυναν·

verses.translation: So their heart was brought low with troubles; they were weak, and there was no helper.

translations.ron: El a umilit întru osteneli inima lor; slăbit-au şi nu era cine să le ajute;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐταπεινώθη ἐν κόποις ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν, ἠσθένησαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν.

verses.translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he saved them out of their distresses.

translations.ron: Dar au strigat către Domnul în necazurile lor şi din nevoile lor i-a izbăvit pe ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἔσωσεν αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And he brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bonds asunder.

translations.ron: Şi i-a scos pe ei din întuneric şi din umbra morţii şi legăturile lor le-a rupt.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ σκότους καὶ σκιᾶς θανάτου, καὶ τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν διέῤῥηξεν.

verses.translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonders to the children of men.

translations.ron: Lăudat să fie Domnul pentru milele Lui, pentru minunile Lui, pe care le-a făcut fiilor oamenilor!
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ Κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.translation: For he broke to pieces the brazen gates, and crushed the iron bars.

translations.ron: Că a sfărâmat porţi de aramă şi zăvoare de fier a frânt
translations.grk: Ὅτι συνέτριψε πύλας χαλκᾶς, καὶ μοχλοὺς σιδηροὺς συνέθλασεν.

verses.translation: He helped them out of the way of their iniquity; for they were brought low because of their iniquities.

translations.ron: Şi i-a ajutat să iasă din calea fărădelegii lor, căci pentru fărădelegile lor au fost umiliţi.
translations.grk: Ἀντελάβετο αὐτῶν ἐξ ὁδοῦ ἀνομίας αὐτῶν, διὰ γὰρ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν ἐταπεινώθησαν.

verses.translation: Their soul abhorred all meat; and they drew near to the gates of death.

translations.ron: Urât-a sufletul lor orice mâncare şi s-au apropiat de porţile morţii.
translations.grk: Πᾶν βρῶμα ἐβδελύξατο ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἤγγισαν ἕως τῶν πυλῶν τοῦ θανάτου.

verses.translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he saved them out of their distresses.

translations.ron: Dar au strigat către Domnul în necazurile lor şi din nevoile lor i-a izbăvit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἔσωσεν αὐτούς.

verses.translation: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them out of their destructions.

translations.ron: Trimis-a cuvântul Său şi i-a vindecat pe ei şi i-a izbăvit pe ei din stricăciunile lor.
translations.grk: Ἀπέστειλε τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἰάσατο αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐῤῥύσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν διαφθορῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

translations.ron: Lăudat să fie Domnul pentru milele Lui, pentru minunile Lui, pe care le-a făcut fiilor oamenilor!
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ Κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων·

verses.translation: And let them offer to him the sacrifice of praise, and proclaim his works with exultation.

translations.ron: Şi să-I jertfească Lui jertfă de laudă şi să vestească lucrurile Lui, în bucurie.
translations.grk: Καὶ θυσάτωσαν αὐτῷ θυσίαν αἰνέσεως, καὶ ἐξαγγειλάτωσαν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει.

verses.translation: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in many waters;

translations.ron: Cei ce se coboară la mare în corăbii, cei ce-şi fac lucrarea lor în ape multe,
translations.grk: Οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς θάλασσαν ἐν πλοίοις, ποιοῦντες ἐργασίαν ἐν ὕδασι πολλοῖς,

verses.translation: these men have seen the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

translations.ron: Aceia au văzut lucrurile Domnului şi minunile Lui întru adânc.
translations.grk: αὐτοὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ βυθῷ.

verses.translation: He speaks, and the stormy wind arises, and its waves are lifted up.

translations.ron: El a zis şi s-a pornit vânt furtunos şi s-au înălţat valurile mării.
translations.grk: Εἶπε, καὶ ἔστη πνεῦμα καταιγίδος, καὶ ὑψώθη τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: They go up to the heavens, and go down to the depths; their soul melts because of troubles.

translations.ron: Se urcau până la ceruri şi se coborau până în adâncuri, iar sufletul lor întru primejdii încremenea.
translations.grk: Ἀναβαίνουσιν ἕως τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ καταβαίνουσιν ἕως τῶν ἀβύσσων· ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ἐν κακοῖς ἐτήκετο,

verses.translation: They are troubled, they stagger as a drunkard, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

translations.ron: Se tulburau şi se clătinau ca un om beat şi toată priceperea lor a pierit.
translations.grk: ἐταράχθησαν, ἐσαλεύθησαν ὡς ὁ μεθύων, καὶ πᾶσα ἡ σοφία αὐτῶν κατεπόθη.

verses.translation: Then they cry to the Lord in their affliction, and he brings them out of their distresses.

translations.ron: Dar au strigat către Domnul în necazurile lor şi din nevoile lor ia izbăvit
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἐξήγαγεν αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And he commands the storm, and it is calmed into a gentle breeze, and its waves are still.

translations.ron: Şi i-a poruncit furtunii şi s-a liniştit şi au tăcut valurile mării.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέταξε τῇ καταιγίδι, καὶ ἔστη εἰς αὖραν, καὶ ἐσίγησαν τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: And they are glad, because they are quiet; and he guides them to their desired haven.

translations.ron: Şi s-au veselit ei, că s-au liniştit valurile şi Domnul i-a povăţuit pe ei la limanul dorit de ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐφράνθησαν, ὅτι ἡσύχασαν, καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ λιμένα θελήματος αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

translations.ron: Lăudat să fie Domnul pentru milele Lui, pentru minunile Lui, pe care le-a făcut fiilor oamenilor!
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ Κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.translation: Let them exalt him in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

translations.ron: Înălţaii-L pe El în adunarea poporului şi în scaunul bătrânilor lăudaţi-L pe El,
translations.grk: Ὑψωσάτωσαν αὐτὸν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐν καθέδρᾳ πρεσβυτέρων αἰνεσάτωσαν αὐτόν.

verses.translation: He turns rivers into a desert, and streams of water into a dry land;

translations.ron: Prefăcut-a râurile în pământ pustiu, izvoarele de apă în pământ însetat
translations.grk: Ἔθετο ποταμοὺς εἰς ἐρήμον, καὶ διεξόδους ὑδάτων εἰς δίψαν·

verses.translation: a fruitful land into saltness, for the wickedness of them that dwell in it.

translations.ron: Şi pământul cel roditor în pământ sărat, din pricina celor ce locuiesc pe el.
translations.grk: Γῆν καρποφόρον εἰς ἅλμην, ἀπὸ κακίας τῶν κατοικούντων ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.translation: He turns a wilderness into pools of water, and a dry land into streams of water.

translations.ron: Prefăcut-a pustiul în iezer de ape, iar pământul cel fără de apă în izvoare de ape,
translations.grk: Ἔθετο ἔρημον εἰς λίμνας ὑδάτων, καὶ γῆν ἄνυδρον εἰς διεξόδους ὑδάτων.

verses.translation: And there he causes the hungry to dwell, and they establish for themselves cities of habitation.

translations.ron: Şi a aşezat acolo pe cei flămânzi şi au zidit cetate de locuit
translations.grk: Καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐκεῖ πεινῶντας, καὶ συνεστήσαντο πόλεις κατοικεσίας·

verses.translation: And they sow fields, and plant vineyards, and they yield fruit of increase.

translations.ron: Şi au semănat ţarine şi au sădit vii şi au strâns belşug de roade
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσπειραν ἀγροὺς, καὶ ἐφύτευσαν ἀμπελῶνας, καὶ ἐποίησαν καρπὸν γεννήματος.

verses.translation: And he blesses them, and they multiply exceedingly, and he diminishes not the number of their cattle.

translations.ron: Şi i-a binecuvântat pe ei şi s-au înmulţit foarte şi vitele lor nu le-a împuţinat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐσμίκρυνε.

verses.translation: Again they become few, and are brought low, by the pressure of evils and pain.

translations.ron: Şi iarăşi au fost împuţinaţi şi chinuiţi de apăsarea necazurilor şi a durerii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὠλιγώθησαν καὶ ἐκακώθησαν ἀπὸ θλίψεως κακῶν καὶ ὀδύνης.

verses.translation: Contempt is poured upon their princes, and he causes them to wander in a desert and trackless land.

translations.ron: Aruncat-a dispreţ asupra căpeteniilor lor şi i-a rătăcit pe ei în loc neumblat şi fără de cale.
translations.grk: Ἐξεχύθη ἐξουδένωσις ἐπʼ ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπλάνησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀβάτῳ καὶ οὐχ ὁδῷ.

verses.translation: But he helps the poor out of poverty, and makes him families as a flock.

translations.ron: Dar pe sărac l-a izbăvit de sărăcie şi i-a pus pe ei ca pe nişte oi de moştenire.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐβοήθησε πένητι ἐκ πτωχείας, καὶ ἔθετο ὡς πρόβατα πατριάς·

verses.translation: The upright shall see and rejoice; and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

translations.ron: Vedea-vor drepţii şi se vor veseli şi toată fărădelegea îşi va astupa gura ei.
translations.grk: Ὄψονται εὐθεῖς καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται, καὶ πᾶσα ἀνομία ἐμφράξει τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Who is wise, and will observe these things, and understand the mercies of the Lord?

translations.ron: Cine este înţelept va păzi acestea şi va pricepe milele Domnului.
translations.grk: Τίς σοφὸς καὶ φυλάξει ταῦτα, καὶ συνήσει τὰ ἐλέη τοῦ Κυρίου;
